buyBody: A mallet cover in signature white and gold, right or left hand. A mallet needs a mallet-shaped cover, which is why this one is separate from the blade.

four.v: It knows which hand you play
Ships in one to two days

details.headline: Your putter head is the part everyone sees
paras: Eighteen times a round, from four feet away, standing still. It also spends the other four hours wedged against a set of irons in a cart going over kerbs.
A year from now it is the reason the putter still looks like the photos.

details.headline: Mallets, in either hand
paras: Cut for a mallet head: the Tracer LGP02, and most other mallets. Pick the hand you play. A mallet cover is not symmetrical and the wrong one will not sit right.
Playing a blade? The Lucky Blade Cover is the shape you want.

rows.v: Mallet heads, including the Tracer LGP02

gallery: Lucky mallet putter cover, signature white
_heavy: Cole 2026-08-19: the same ruling as the Blade. This page was selling a $30 cover by calling our own $229 putter 'the worst-shaped thing in your bag', 'wide and awkward' and 'wide, flat and heavy'. The cover's case does not need the putter to be bad: the head is the part everyone sees and the part a cart dings.
